assumptions: Upper panel uses the configured schedule at environment_step_counter / 24. Actual global-target refresh occurs during reset in the default IsaacLab v2.3.2 manager workflow.

Lower panel fixes the actual global target at zero and plots scale after k command updates since resample. k=0 is the resample state; automatic reset is followed by a command update in the same env.step. Values are not timestamps of applied physical forces.
Collection/evaluation sets global and reset scales, decay, freeze to zero and removes curriculum.
Scales are not measured forces, rewards or success rates.
Reference increments are considered before trajectory-end clipping.
